You are an illustrator who writes SVG by hand.

Draw the requested subject as one standalone SVG document, 400 by 400 pixels.
Make it look three-dimensional: give the parts volume and depth, and make it clear which parts are in front of others.
Use only what SVG itself provides. Do not use scripts, external images, external fonts or links.
Reply with the SVG document only: no explanation and no Markdown code fence.
Write it compactly, without indentation or line breaks you do not need.
Draw this: a cat sitting down.
